name: Kinyarwanda
translator_note: A full working Kinyarwanda translation of the interface, written in plain transactional register. Carried for travellers crossing the south-western border and for Rwandan residents in Kampala. Written by UG rather than by a first-language speaker; the correction button is on every screen and a Rwandan speaker's edit outranks anything here.

strings.page.p.ug_speaks_the_languages: UG ivuga indimi z'u Buganda, iz'akarere, n'iz'abashyitsi bayo. Hitamo iyawe; ibindi byose bikurikira.
strings.top.p.one_app_that_quotes: Porogaramu imwe igereranya ibiciro by'urugendo rwose ku isoko rya Uganda ku ruhande rumwe, igasangiza urugendo rw'ibirometero kugira ngo Prado ihendutse inshuro enye, igakodesha imodoka igihe ugomba kugera neza, kandi ikabika ipariki mbere y'uko impushya zishira. Wishyura uko Kampala yishyura: amafaranga yo kuri telefoni.
strings.doorRiderSub: Saba intebe, ugereranye ingendo zose, utegure impera z'icyumweru.
strings.doorDriverSub: Vuga aho wishimira. Ingendo zishyuwe ziza kuri wowe.
strings.top.a.just_compare_prices_no: Gereranya ibiciro gusa, nta konti ikenewe
strings.top.span.send_the_thing_any: Ohereza ikintu, ingano iyo ari yo yose
strings.top.div.prototype_v1_every_price: Igerageza v1 · buri giciro ni igereranyo rivuye mu buryo bwasohotse · ubwishyu bukorera mu igerageza · nta serivisi ifite uruhushya iri hano
strings.compare.h2.every_ride_on_the: Urugendo rwose ku isoko, ku rupapuro rumwe, rutondetswe ku giciro.
strings.compare.summary.what_choosing_badly_cost: Icyo guhitamo nabi gitwara <small>itandukaniro ry'ibiciro kuri uru rugendo</small>
strings.compare.summary.the_atlas_every_way: Atlas · uburyo bwose bwo kugenda, ku meza amwe <small>indege, bisi, amazi, gari ya moshi, imodoka za Signature, n'aho kuraramo, n'ukuri ku buri bumwe</small>
strings.compare.p.book_on_ug_where: Fata kuri UG aho umuyoboro uhari, Hamagara mbere aho udahari, Iri ku rutonde ku kumenyekana, Iraza ku bigikorwa. Ibiciro ni ibigereranyo kandi birabivuga.
strings.stage.div.the_virtual_stage_seats: Isitasiyo ya digitale · intebe zibanza kuzura, imodoka ikaza
strings.stage.h2.pay_for_the_seat: Ishyura intebe. Imodoka iza iyo yuzuye.
strings.stage.p.like_a_matatu_stage: Nk'isitasiyo ya matatu, imodoka igenda iyo yuzuye cyangwa ku isaha ntarengwa. Gusa hano, wishyura uri ku ntebe yawe mu rugo, igiciro cy'intebe kigabanuka uko inshuti zinjira, kandi umushoferi uyitwara yamaze kuvuga ko yumva amerewe neza kuri uwo muhanda.
strings.stage.summary.where_stages_fill_fastest: Aho amasitasiyo yuzura vuba <small>Pulse · intebe zishyuwe kuri buri mujyi</small>
strings.stage.summary.buses_on_this_corridor: Bisi kuri uyu muhanda <small>ubundi buryo, ku ruhande rw'isitasiyo</small>
strings.stage.p.every_corridor_also_has: Buri muhanda kandi ufite bisi. Gereranya amasaha yo kugenda ku bakora bose, urebe aho uva, kandi ufate kuri UG aho uwo bikorera yemera kubika kuri interineti. Aho atabyemera, turabikubwira tukaguha nimero yo guhamagara, aho kuguha buto ipfuye.
strings.stage.summary.empty_legs_the_return: Ingendo zo kugaruka <small>intebe zo kugaruka, 40% by'igiciro</small>
strings.stage.p.every_rental_with_driver: Buri modoka ikodeshwa n'umushoferi na buri rugendo rusangiwe rufite inzira yo kugaruka. Igihe urugendo rwo kujya rufatiwe, intebe zo kugaruka zitangira kugurishwa.
strings.stage.summary.post_a_trip_of: Tanga urugendo rwawe, cyangwa urebe igiciro cy'intebe <small>Pool · itsinda ryawe, igiciro nyacyo cy'umuhanda kigabanyijwe ku ntebe</small>
strings.stage.h3.offer_a_seat_or: Tanga intebe, cyangwa urebe icyo intebe yagombye gutwara
strings.stage.p.posted_trips_live_only: Ingendo zatanzwe ziba muri iyi mushakisha gusa kugeza winjiye. Pool ikurikira uburyo bumwe: konti zemejwe na telefoni, ikiganiro cy'urugendo, no gutanga amanota impande zombi, hamwe n'amatsinda kugira ngo ugende n'abantu usanzwe uzi.
strings.rent.p.self_drive_by_the: Twara wenyine ku munsi, cyangwa n'umushoferi ku isaha, cyangwa Signature igihe kugera ari byo bikuru. Igiciro ni ku muntu iyo mugabanye.
strings.deliver.h2.send_the_thing_any: Ohereza ikintu. Ingano iyo ari yo yose, intera iyo ari yo yose.
strings.deliver.p.every_courier_in_town: Abatwara ibintu bose bo mu mujyi ku rupapuro rumwe, batondetswe. Mu ntara, ipaki igenda mu mizigo y'imodoka y'isitasiyo ku kimwe cya kane cy'intebe, kandi mu gihe cy'isarura minibus, pikipiki cyangwa kamyo n'umushoferi.
strings.deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug: Ibiciro by'abatwara ibintu ni ibigereranyo bya UG bivuye mu buryo bwasohotse; 8 to 8 i Jinja yavuzwe mu nyandiko y'uwatangije kandi igiciro cyayo ni igereranyo. Ipaki kuri Isitasiyo ni igiciro cya UG bwite: ikimwe cya kane cy'intebe kuri iyo sitasiyo, cyishyurwa umushoferi hamwe n'intebe.
strings.explore.div.explore_the_pearl_priced: Sura · Ikinyoni cya Afurika, ku giciro nyacyo
strings.explore.h2.the_whole_park_weekend: Impera z'icyumweru muri pariki zose, mu mubare umwe.
strings.explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle: Kwinjira muri pariki, impushya, amafaranga y'imodoka, aho kuraramo, amafaranga y'ibiryo n'inzira, byose byabaruwe ku baturage ba Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, abanyamahanga batuye hano n'abashyitsi. Abaturage ba Afurika y'Iburasirazuba bishyura ibiciro bya Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
strings.explore.summary.chain_a_whole_day: Huza umunsi wose <small>Hustle Mode · buri gice cyabaruwe ku buryo buhendutse; ikofi n'ingengabihe ni iby'igerageza</small>
strings.explore.div.ug_wallet_sandbox_balance: Ikofi ya UG · amafaranga y'igerageza, si ay'ukuri
strings.drive.h2.say_where_you_are: Vuga aho wumva umerewe neza, rimwe. Emera imodoka zuzuye.
strings.drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting: Nta gutanga, nta gutegereza kuri isitasiyo, nta guhatana. Ikarita y'aho wumva umerewe neza ni yo yonyine ubungabunga: aho ukorera, intera, imihanda, amasaha, n'ibyo utemera. Ingendo zishyuwe ziza zifite amafaranga imbere.
strings.drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming: Aho abantu bazakenerera imodoka muri iki cyumweru <small>Foresight · isarura, ibirori n'imigenzo, icyumweru imbere, ku bwoko bw'imodoka</small>
strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Sezerana kuhaba maze icyuho gifungirwe buri wese. Icyizere kigaragazwa kuri buri kimenyetso; ibihe ni amategeko kugeza isarura rya mbere ribyigishije.
strings.drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per: Icyizere kigaragazwa kuri buri kimenyetso; ibihe ni amategeko kugeza hari ingendo zuzuye zo kwigiraho.
strings.install.h2.the_site_is_the: Urubuga ni yo porogaramu. Yishyire, cyangwa usome kode.
strings.install.p.one_link_on_the: Umuyoboro umwe kuri interineti no kuri telefoni: konti imwe, amasitasiyo amwe, n'Ikirangantego kimwe ku rupapuro rw'itangiriro. Nta kugenda muri sitolo.
strings.install.p.scan_with_the_camera: Soma na kamera. Kode ifungura uwo muyoboro; injira na nimero imwe maze byose bibe hano.
strings.install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver: Genda. Sangira. Kodesha. Ohereza. Isoko ry'ingendo rya Uganda ku bantu bafite aho bagana n'ingengo y'imari yo kubahiriza.
strings.modal.span.checkout_by_flutterwave_sandb: Kwishyura na Flutterwave · ni iby'igerageza kugeza urufunguzo nyarwo rushyizweho
strings.plugModal.label.api_key_or_token: Urufunguzo rwa API (rubikwa kuri iki gikoresho)
strings.hsModal.span.phone_verified_account_noth: Konti yemejwe na telefoni · nta kintu cyishyuwe
strings.railModal.span.booked_and_tracked_on: Rwafashwe kandi rukurikiranwa kuri UG. Umufasha ni uw'igerageza muri iri gerageza.
strings.railModal.div.reduce_motionno_opening_an: Gabanya kunyeganyegaNta nimasiyo yo gutangira, nta duce dutemba
strings.railModal.div.underline_linksevery_link_: Shyira umurongo ku miyoboroBuri muyoboro ufite umurongo, si ibara gusa
strings.railModal.p.ug_also_follows_your: UG ikurikira kandi amagenamiterere ya sisitemu yawe ku kunyeganyega no ku itandukaniro, ikorana n'umusomyi w'urupapuro, ikoreshwa na klavye yose, kandi yumva amajwi ubinyujije kuri buto ya mikoro cyangwa muri Cephable. Tubwire icyagufasha: hello@ug.example.
strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Buri mujyi uri ku ikarita ni umuhanda uva i Kampala kandi ni isitasiyo yawo bwite. Aho porogaramu yo mu karere isanzwe ikora, UG iyiha urugendo rwa nyuma aho kwiyerekana ko ihari.
strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Amakarita ava kuri Felt. Imirimo y'ikirere iva kuri Infrared City. Imyidagaduro iva kuri Tazama. Kugenzura n'ijwi biva kuri Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Buri cyongewe gifite aho kigana n'urufunguzo rwacyo, bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho kugeza winjiye. Huza kimwe maze buto zibigenewe zifungurwe muri Pool, Sura na Hustle Mode. Nta kintu kiva muri UG utabanje gufungura icyongewe.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Abo duhatana na bo bari ku rutonde ku bushake. Umugenzi wizera igereranya agaruka ku pool no ku ikodeshwa.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG ni isoko mbere na mbere. Porogaramu z'ingendo zibona ibyabikijwe byuzuye nta mafaranga yo gushakisha abakiriya. Ababika imodoka babona abakodesha bagenzuwe. Amahoteli abona amatsinda agera ku itariki izwi. Abashoferi babona umuhanda wuzuye mbere yo kugenda.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Abashoferi n'ibyapa byemejwe, buto y'ubutabazi mu rugendo isangiza aho uri n'uwo wahisemo, ingofero kuri buri boda isangiwe, n'inyemezabwishyu kuri buri shilingi.
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Icumi ku ijana kuri pool, igiciro kimwe cyo kwandika ku ikodeshwa, kwishyurwa buri cyumweru kuri MoMo binyuze kuri Flutterwave, n'abakiriya utagombye kwamamaza.
strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Imiyoboro ifungura porogaramu yawe aho utangirira n'aho ugana byuzuyemo. Ntitwerekana igiciro tutabaze mu mucyo, kandi uburyo burasohorwa.
strings.langNote: Indimi zitarasuzumwa n'umuvugizi kavukire zisubira mu Cyongereza aho ijambo ribuze. Dufashe kurangiza iyawe.
strings.ui.reviewNote: Ubuhinduzi bwakozwe na UG bunasuzumwa ubwa kabiri; isuzuma ry'umuvugizi kavukire rifunguye. Amagambo abuze asubira mu Cyongereza.
